robin: starting a quick thread to assemble the release note bullets and the changelog entry for tomorrow's docs deploy. need a sweep on SDK snippets, curl examples, and a short known-issues list.
jamie: on it. PRs to include: #5012 (whatsnew copy), #5020 (embed examples), #5024 (sdk snippet fixes). also add the streaming shape caveat to known issues.
taylor: i noticed the curl example in #5020 uses `embed_model` while the JS snippet uses `model` 10. we should standardize.
robin: good catch. for the docs site we'll use bullets (1-2 sentences) with CTAs linking to deeper pages. keep language non-technical for customer-facing whatsnew.
alex: i pushed an updated TS snippet in #5024. python streaming sample still needs a tweak the client now yields event dicts.
jamie: here's the python snippet we should publish (updated):
```python
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
for event in client.generate_stream(model="kestrel", prompt="Welcome"):
    if event.get("type") == "token":
        print(event.get("delta", ""), end="")
    elif event.get("type") == "done":
        print('\n-- stream complete --')
```
taylor: add a one-line note above the snippet: "Streaming responses include control events (type: 'done') and token events (type: 'token')."
morgan: i'll run a quick grep for /embed vs /embeds and open redirects for mismatches. found two stale links in the staging redirect map.
robin: known-issue proposal: "Embeddings produced by quantized backends may differ slightly from float backends; test on a representative prompt set before switching in prod." keep it short.
alex: +1. also include a short note about fallback routing: "Requests may be routed to compatible model variants during capacity events; results can differ by model variant."
jamie: assigning reviewers: @robin + @taylor on #5024, @alex on #5012, @morgan on #5020.
docbot: CI | docs-lint: passed ✅ (build 3168)
taylor: phrasing nit for embedding perf: prefer "reduced latency for small inputs" rather than jargon like "tail latency". marketing ok with simpler phrasing.
morgan: i'll update the curl examples to use the canonical param and leave a redirect for the old path.
robin: timeline: final copy by 17:00 PT, freeze at 18:00 PT, deploy in the next window. if anything blocks, flag here.
alex: final checklist i have: python streaming snippet updated, TS snippet merged, curl params normalized, embedding known-issue added, link sweep done.
jamie: i'll consolidate the whatsnew bullets once the PRs are merged and post the final diff here.
robin: perfect. will pin for visibility in #docs and ping product for the customer-facing blurb. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
